Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: the Employment Info path; the action and reason names; that a regular HCM (not a super-user) sees Our Workforce and this quick action.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

Change Assignment is the transaction for broader changes to an employee's current assignment, or for several changes in one transaction. Examples: ACA eligibility, default expense account, leave status, the primary indicator, or an update that touches several fields or sections.

For a single change, use the direct action when one is available: Change Manager, Change Location, Direct Reports, or Change Working Hours. Start from Employment Info so you can review the record before you change it.

Use this whenAn employee's assignment needs a broader update, or several changes in one transaction. For one change that has a direct action, use that action instead.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Titles in Oracle
TitleWhat it is
Position TitleThe name given to the position
Job TitleThe Job Architecture (job code) title tied to the position
Business TitleThe department's working title. You can update it on the assignment.

Before you submit

The same four checks on every pay-impacting transaction. Draft: the owner for this area confirms anything marked To confirm.

Attach

None named yet.

To confirmNo document is named for this transaction yet.

Check

Read every field back against the source document: person, effective date, position, hours, pay, and costing.

  • For one change that has a direct action (manager, location, working hours, direct reports), use that action instead.
  • The effective date is when the change takes effect. The payroll calendar shows which payroll processes it.
  • Salary is selected and reviewed if the change affects pay.
  • Position Override toggles are checked, especially Manager Name.
  • After a reclassification: fields the position may not update are checked (which ones is to confirm).

Cutoff

Monthly (exempt) pay: the change must be fully approved by the HCM Transaction Cutoff, the 18th in most months and earlier in December. Check the HR/Payroll Calendar. Pending approvals do not pay. A change still waiting in approvals at the cutoff misses that payroll.

Who does what

  • Who starts it: You.
  • Who approves: To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.
  • What happens next: Payroll pays from the approved assignment.

Watch-outs

  • Change Assignment is the whole transaction; Assignment Change is one type of change inside it. Leave Status is a separate type with its own action reasons, so don't look for it under Assignment Change.
  • Don't let a position override replace the employee's real manager. Check Manager Name before you leave its toggle on.
  • One employee can have three different titles: Position, Job, and Business.
  • Open item: confirm whether moving an employee to another position in the same business unit uses Assignment Change (reason Position Change Within a Business Unit) or Transfer. The course and knowledge check will be updated once it is confirmed.
  • Open item: confirm which sections (Manager, Salary, Direct Reports, Payroll Details, Compensation, Comments and Attachments) are required, optional, or conditional for each type of change.
  • Open item: confirm the full list of assignment fields HCMs must maintain, such as work-from-home status, manager status, remote or hybrid work, working with minors, and driving for the university. Until it is confirmed, ask HRIS rather than deciding which fields are required.
  • Open item: confirm how the effective date, the payroll cutoff, and payroll processing relate when a change is entered after the monthly (exempt) cutoff. Missing the cutoff should not be read as changing the effective date.
  • Open item: confirm which fields must be updated by hand on the assignment after a position reclassification.
  • Open item: confirm what belongs in Official Documentation, when to use it, whether it is required, and how it differs from Comments and Attachments.
  • Open item: confirm which assignment transactions need approval and which do not (for example, Change Manager).

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Redwood employment pages incl. Change Assignment and Change Working Hours (26C) (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Assignment Changes

Change Assignment

Use when: An employee's assignment needs a broader update, or several changes in one transaction. For one change that has a direct action, use that action instead. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Open the employee's Employment Info.
  2. Pick a direct action or Change Assignment.
    • One change with a direct action (Change Manager, Change Location, Direct Reports, Change Working Hours): the three-dot menu
    • Broader changes, or several fields at once: Change Assignment
  3. Select the sections this transaction needs, then Continue.
    • Manager
    • Salary
    • Direct Reports
    • Payroll Details
    • Compensation
    • Comments and Attachments
  4. Enter the effective date.
  5. Choose the type of change, then the action reason.
  6. Check the Position Override toggles.
    • On (blue): take the value from the position
    • Off (gray): keep the assignment's current value
  7. Verify the manager before the position overrides it.
  8. Update the fields that are changing, including the Business Title.
  9. Fill in the required assignment information.
  10. After a reclassification, check the fields the position may not update.
  11. Review, submit, and track approval.
